title: Marq AI now works in Slack
summary: Paste a URL in Slack to request enforcement against counterfeits, gray-market listings or impersonation, and check your status. No login, no switching tools.
body_markdown:
Introducing Marq AI’s new Slack integration.


No more logging in to the dashboard. Request enforcement and check your brand protection status, all from Slack.


Paste a suspicious URL into Slack and an enforcement request is created. Marq AI handles the rest, and you can follow progress in real time in the same Slack thread where your team is already talking.


## **Why response gets delayed**


Brand protection work shows up without warning.


A partner shares a suspicious link, a customer reports a counterfeit, or ahead of an important meeting an executive asks in a Slack channel, “Why are there so many fakes online?”


Until now, though, the response happened somewhere else. You logged in to the platform and filed the request yourself, or passed it to your CS manager and waited for it to be entered by hand.


Threats don’t grow because no one found them. They grow in the time between finding them and acting on them. The Marq AI Slack integration closes that gap. Request brand protection work in Slack, and Marq AI starts acting immediately. No login, no switching platforms, no entering the same thing twice.


## **Request enforcement in one message**


#### ***> \`/enforce {URL}\`***


Type /enforce and paste a suspicious URL, and an enforcement request is created instantly.


Marq AI checks the brand and the channel, then files the enforcement request in the MarqVision dashboard. While action proceeds on that channel, whether a domain, web content, social media or a marketplace, the Slack bot posts real-time progress updates in the same thread.


## **Check your brand’s status in Slack too**


#### ***> \`/summary\`***


Get a **daily or weekly** brand protection summary delivered to any Slack channel you choose.


Marq AI summarizes activity by channel (scanned, flagged, reported, removed), takedowns in progress, and anomalies that need attention first. No separate report to build, no dashboard to open.


## **The start of a bigger change**


The Marq AI Slack integration is the first service built on MarqVision’s Action-Enabled API.


The API lets AI agents carry out any task you’d otherwise do in the MarqVision platform. Work that used to be possible only in the dashboard can now happen in tools like Slack.


Slack is the first channel, not the last. Today it supports two commands, /enforce and /summary. Next, you’ll be able to describe what you want in plain language, and Marq AI will understand it and do the work for you.


## **Get started**


The Marq AI Slack integration is currently available to a first group of customers. Those already using it are working with MarqVision to run brand protection fully through agents inside Slack, refining everything from command design to summary format to how results are shared across the team.


The integration will roll out to all customers over the coming weeks. To start sooner, contact your CSM or[join the Marq AI Slack integration waitlist](https://www.marqvision.com/request-demo?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=Slack_Integration&utm_content=launch_blog) .
